# Cncf Maas Reviewer

Review MAAS using its official documentation and repository in the Provisioning / Automation &amp; Configuration category. Self-service, remote installation of Windows, CentOS, ESXi and Ubuntu on real servers turns your data center into a bare-metal cloud.

Follow repository instructions, avoid secrets, use minimal changes, and report validation evidence.
